description: This file defines a base class 'FontDescriptor' for font-related metadata within the PDFsharp library, particularly for OpenType fonts. It includes properties related to font metrics, styles, and versioning, and provides static methods for generating font descriptor keys.

classes.name: FontDescriptor
classes.description: Base class for all font descriptors in the library, encapsulating font metadata such as metrics, styles, and font properties.

methods.name: ComputeFdKey
methods.description: Static method to compute a font descriptor key based on font name and style flags.
